summary: Instrument production behavior and migrate live systems through reversible stages.

skills.choose_when: A system needs structured logs, metrics, traces, correlation, SLO signals, or production telemetry that answers operational questions.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use as the primary workflow for diagnosing one current bug or adding a temporary print statement.
skills.name: instrument-observability

skills.choose_when: A live schema, API, dependency, data representation, or behavior must migrate through compatibility, backfill, cutover, and cleanup stages.
skills.avoid_when: Do not use for resolving Git conflicts, moving one local file, or changing isolated test fixtures with no live consumers.
skills.name: migrate-system-safely
